summary: Frontend-only testing of 3 new Magazine Builder features (Media Library, Master Pages, expanded Page Templates). All 9 requested checks passed via admin login -> Magazine Builder tab -> open magazine -> editor. Verified: (1) Media Library button [data-testid=media-library-btn] in toolbar opens modal with 'Upload Images' button and empty state 'No images in library yet / Upload images to reuse across pages'. (2) Master Pages button [data-testid=master-pages-btn] opens modal with Header/Footer sections each having 'Add Header Text' / 'Add Footer Text' buttons and empty-state messages. (3) 'Apply Master Elements To' dropdown lists exactly: 'All Pages', 'All Except Cover (First Page)', 'Custom Selection'. (4) Page Templates modal [data-testid=page-templates-modal] shows all 5 categories (BASIC, PORTFOLIO, CONTENT, UTILITY, ADS) and exactly 21 template cards ([data-testid^=page-template-]). (5) All 11 required new/expanded templates present: Three Images, Featured + Grid, Bio + Sidebar, Career Timeline, Achievements, Behind the Scenes, Contact Page, Social Links, Credits Page, Table of Contents, Content + Ad. Also includes 'Tip: use {{page}} placeholder' for page numbering in Master Pages modal.

issues: Toolbar now has 22+ icon-only buttons in a single row (Media Library and Master Pages added). Grouping/dividers still recommended for readability.

action_items: Optional: Consider splitting MagazineBuilder.jsx (now 2425 lines, was 1865 in iter 14) into subcomponents (Toolbar, MediaLibraryModal, MasterPagesModal, PageTemplatesModal, LayersPanel, PropertiesPanel, Canvas). Well past the <700 line guideline.
Optional: Add data-testid to Apply-to <select>, Add Header Text/Add Footer Text buttons, and Media Library upload input to make future test automation more robust.
critical_code_review_comments: MagazineBuilder.jsx = 2425 lines - substantially exceeds 700-line guideline; should be modularized.

PAGE_TEMPLATES array defined at module scope with 21 entries and Master Pages/Media Library state co-located in the same component - good candidates for extraction into ./magazine/components and ./magazine/constants.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing magazine card in Magazine Builder list.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New editor toolbar test IDs: media-library-btn, master-pages-btn (in addition to previously documented add-text/rectangle/circle/line/image, undo/redo, toggle-grid/layers, preview-mode, save-magazine-btn, export-pdf-btn, export-instagram-btn). Modals: [data-testid=media-library-modal], [data-testid=master-pages-modal], [data-testid=page-templates-modal]. Page template cards: [data-testid=page-template-<id>] where id ∈ {blank, cover, profile, portfolio_grid, portfolio_2col, portfolio_3img, portfolio_featured, interview, full_bleed, quote, bio_sidebar, timeline, achievements, behind_scenes, contact, social_links, credits, toc, ad_full, ad_half, ad_sidebar} = 21 total. Master Pages supports {{page}} placeholder. Master Pages apply modes: 'all', 'except_cover', 'custom' (with excluded pages input).
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found. All 9 features work as specified in the review request.
